title.zh: Secret Service Freezes $52.8 Million in Crypto Tied to Telegram Bazaar Behind Global Scams
title.en: Secret Service Freezes $52.8 Million in Crypto Tied to Telegram Bazaar Behind Global Scams

current_state.zh: U.S. Secret Service froze $52.8 million in USDT linked to Telegram-based scam marketplace Xinbi, which was also designated by OFAC as a significant transnational criminal organization.
